_readme: Seed file. daysAgo + time (HH:MM, 24h IST) are relative: seed.js converts to real dates at seed time. expectedLabel is ground truth for testing only and must NOT be shown in the UI. Labels: assistant_reply | client_reply | no_reply | needs_review. Tags: meeting, action_required, important, general, waiting_for_response. assignedTo = handled by (assistantId). messages[].sentBy = who replied (assistantId or OWN-001). dueInDays and meeting.inDays are days from seed time. snoozedForDays = days left on snooze. ownerAction = owner marked handled or took over (with note). activity = explicit audit entries; seed.js also derives reply_sent entries from outgoing messages.
